observations: Two beige and blue industrial machines stand side by side on casters.
Left machine has two oval top openings and a front control panel with push buttons.
Right machine has a digital display panel, exposed blue mechanical drive, pressure gauges, and a vertical guide column.
Wall is painted salmon above white tiles; white pipes run vertically.
Watermark text "TJ GLOBAL MACHINERY POSTED ON JIJI" is overlaid on the image.
No machine brand or model plate is legible in the photo.

claims.claim: Pet blower machine for production of plastic bottle
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows equipment consistent with blow molding but no operation, output, or nameplate confirms it

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or complete a blow cycle
risks.proof: video of the machine running through a heating and blowing cycle

risks.risk: Blow molds or preform tooling are missing or mismatched
risks.proof: photo of the mold set and any changeover parts

risks.risk: Electrical supply or phase is incompatible with local power
risks.proof: photo of the electrical rating plate and plug

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical wear or damage inside the guarded areas
risks.proof: close-up video of the clamping and stretching mechanism in motion
risks.if_unproven: as used with unknown mechanical condition

proof_requests: Video of the machine completing a full blow molding cycle
Close-up photo of any nameplate, serial number, or electrical rating plate
Photo of all included molds, preform holders, and tooling
Photo of the control panel powered on showing actual readings
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a PET blow molding machine from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working used equipment without a readable model.
